events.exact_fact_text: 背景/替代解释事件：2026-06-03 16:28:00 UTC，资产 `ws-rnd-04`，关联对象 `files-sync-share.net`，The R&D workstation resolved files-sync-share.net, a rare storage-themed domain, before the seed alert.，源地址 `10.90.2.44`

2026-06-03 16:34:20 UTC，资产 `ws-rnd-04`，关联对象 `files-sync-share.net / 198.51.100.144`，The workstation opened a short TLS session to the rare storage edge before the larger transfer sequence.，源地址 `10.90.2.44`
2026-06-03 16:40:00 UTC，资产 `ws-rnd-04`，关联对象 `files-sync-share.net / 198.51.100.144`，Seed JA4 alert matched a suspicious TLS beacon to the rare storage edge.，源地址 `10.90.2.44`
2026-06-03 16:42:30 UTC，资产 `ws-rnd-04`，PowerShell launched from the user profile and invoked a staging script under C:\Users\analyst\AppData\Roaming\sync.ps1.，源地址 `10.90.2.44`
2026-06-03 16:44:00 UTC，资产 `ws-rnd-04`，Archive utility 7z.exe created RND-Q2-prototype.zip from a project workspace shortly before outbound transfer.，源地址 `10.90.2.44`
2026-06-03 16:45:40 UTC，资产 `ws-rnd-04`，The newly created RND-Q2-prototype.zip was staged under C:\Users\Public\Music\cache.dat for transfer.，源地址 `10.90.2.44`

2026-06-03 16:47:00 UTC，资产 `ws-rnd-04`，关联对象 `files-sync-share.net / 198.51.100.144`，A large outbound HTTPS upload to files-sync-share.net followed the archive creation, with roughly 640 MB sent.，源地址 `10.90.2.44`
2026-06-03 16:50:10 UTC，资产 `ws-rnd-04`，关联对象 `files-sync-share.net / 198.51.100.144`，DLP recorded the encrypted outbound transfer size but could not inspect the archive contents.，源地址 `10.90.2.44`
2026-06-03 16:52:30 UTC，资产 `ws-rnd-04`，关联对象 `api.files-sync-share.net`，The same workstation resolved api.files-sync-share.net, a sibling domain on the same storage edge.，源地址 `10.90.2.44`
2026-06-03 16:55:00 UTC，资产 `ws-rnd-04`，关联对象 `api.files-sync-share.net / 198.51.100.144`，A follow-on TLS session used the sibling API domain after the large upload completed.，源地址 `10.90.2.44`
